messages:
maya: kicking off a canary for renderer service: v3.2.0 -> v3.3.0 in eu-west. change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. plan: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 45m. pin session-handler to v3.2.0 for 5m during first step. see release notes: https://go/release/renderer/3.3.0 :eyes:
aj: ack. who owns rollback criteria? we should declare explicit SLO gates.
sre-oncall: I will own the rollback decision if ERR_RATE > 1% OR p95 latency increases > 30% for 10m. call rollback early if DB latency or auth errors spike.
maya: good. also keep an eye on tail p99 tokenization failure we've seen before. added lightweight smoke tests to the canary.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary for renderer v3.3.0 at 2026-03-21T02:15:45Z. initial weight: 0.10. CI: all checks green.
aj: put the step commands here so ops can run quickly if needed:
```
# shift 10% traffic to new version
rtrctl shift --service=renderer --from-version=v3.2.0 --to-version=v3.3.0 --weight=0.10 --region=eu-west
# increase to 30%
rtrctl shift --service=renderer --to-weight=0.30
# rollback to v3.2.0
rtrctl rollback --service=renderer --target-version=v3.2.0
```
julian: dashboards prepped: /console/renderer/canary (errors / latency / kv-cache hit). I added a short dashboard for tokenization failures and a log tail filter `json.message:tokenize_failure`.
sre-oncall: I've set alert playbook: if errors > 1% AND user-visible errors increase, we 1) pause canary (set weight back to 0.0) 2) trigger rollback 3) open incident channel #inc-<auto-id>.
maya: note: pinning session-handler is important — run this before first shift:
`routerctl pin --service=renderer --component=session-handler --version=v3.2.0 --ttl=300`
aj: can we add a soft-fallback route in case of sustained latency? config snippet I suggest:
```
routing:
  renderer:
    fallback: v3.2.0
    fallback_threshold: 0.02 # 2% of requests
```
will that be applied automatically?
julian: yep routing config live on staging and prod-managed. ops team will enable fallback if needed.
sre-oncall: reminder: metric windows - use 5m sliding windows for decision, escalate after 2 consecutive bad windows. I'll ping in 10m before each weight bump.
maya: ok starting now. ops, SRE, please stand by. I'll post updates after each weight change. :rocket:
(deploy-bot will post progress updates in-thread)
